name: Beauty Studio
selectionBasis: Editorial judgment: recognizable, broadly reusable use case; no verified demand ranking.

variants.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: website template gallery thumbnail, direction A — interface preview.
Create one beautifully art-directed desktop homepage for a independent beauty salon, elegant salon interior and beauty detail photography. Category: Small Business. Concept: Beauty Studio.
Landscape 4:3, straight-on flat website screenshot filling the canvas edge to edge. No device or browser frame, no perspective, no background outside the page. Compact top navigation, dominant hero, beginning of one relevant content section. Strong hierarchy and large focal elements readable at thumbnail size. Premium contemporary typography, disciplined spacing, sector-appropriate palette, original relevant imagery, clear contrast and appealing editorial composition.
Headline verbatim: "Your everyday, elevated.". Primary CTA verbatim: "Book a visit". Only a few short English navigation labels, minimal copy, simple fictional wordmark based on "Beauty Studio".
One website only. No contact sheet, no watermark, no external logos, no fake awards, no popularity claims, no medical outcome claims. Professional, distinctive, commercially useful design.

Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: standalone product/service illustration for a website template thumbnail, direction B — product illustration.
Create one striking premium visual that immediately communicates this website concept: Beauty Studio. Category: Small Business. Subject context: independent beauty salon, elegant salon interior and beauty detail photography.
Landscape 4:3, edge-to-edge polished conceptual illustration, sophisticated tactile 3D and editorial mixed-media treatment, one strong central sector-specific motif with at most 3 supporting elements, rich materials, coherent sector-appropriate palette, sculpted soft light, carefully controlled negative space, strong silhouette readable at thumbnail size. Depict the actual product, service, or creative work represented by this concept. For personal portfolios, resumes and writers, use beautifully arranged original work artifacts as the product; for service businesses, show relevant service tools and an inviting setting. Every object must serve the concept.
No website UI, no screens, no devices, no browser frames, no text or letters, no watermark, no third-party logos, no fake awards, no before/after medical promises. One coherent illustration only; not a contact sheet. Distinctive and professional, not generic clip art.

Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: contextual website mockup for a template gallery thumbnail, direction C — contextual mockup.
Create one photorealistic premium mockup of the "Beauty Studio" website displayed on a single modern unbranded desktop monitor or laptop in a believable setting directly relevant to Small Business. Website subject: independent beauty salon, elegant salon interior and beauty detail photography.
Landscape 4:3. The device screen must occupy about 65–75 percent of the image, be nearly front-facing with only mild perspective, and remain the clear focal point at small thumbnail size. Show a fully designed homepage on the screen: clean navigation, large relevant hero image, refined typography, clear CTA. Headline verbatim: "Your everyday, elevated.". CTA verbatim: "Book a visit". Minimal additional English text and a simple fictional wordmark. Surround with only 2–3 restrained context-specific props and a softly defocused environment. Realistic materials, natural premium light, balanced composition and coherent palette. The screen must be geometrically accurate and readable, without excessive glare.
One device and one scene only. No floating page collage, no contact sheet, no external logos, no watermark, no fake awards, no numeric popularity or medical outcome claims. Make the context genuinely specific to this business, not a generic desk reused for every concept.
